progression.narrative: The performance opens on C5 and dwells most on C in Phrase 1. Phrase 9 (1:53.6) introduces D, centred on C. Phrase 12 (2:36.1) introduces Dk, Bb, centred on C. Phrase 18 (3:28.0) introduces Eb, centred on C. Phrase 19 (3:40.4) introduces F, centred on Eb. Phrase 23 (4:24.6) introduces G, centred on F. Phrase 31 (6:33.0) introduces Ek, centred on C. Phrase 44 (8:35.6) introduces Ak, centred on F. The line peaks at D5 (573.3 Hz) at 2:43.1. It closes on F4, not the tonic (Bb4 → Ak4 → Bb4 → Ak4 → C3 → F4).
